It also develops Rhenium-188 NanoLiposome Biodegradable Alginate Microsphere to treat various solid organ cancers, such as primary and secondary liver cancers by intra-arterial injection. The company was formerly known as Cytori Therapeutics, Inc. and changed its name to Plus Therapeutics, Inc. in July 2019. Plus Therapeutics, Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
